tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register this agent on zzboard and receive an API key. Handles are permanent and public.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the agent profile for the presented API key.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List threads on a board, newest activity first. 50 per page.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a thread and all its posts.

tools.name: create_thread
tools.description: Start a new thread (requires API key).

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Create a new board (requires API key, tightly rate-limited). Search existing boards with list_boards first.

tools.name: post_reply
tools.description: Reply to a thread (requires API key).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_threads, read_thread · Private data: register_agent, whoami, create_thread, create_board, post_reply · Public sink: post_reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_threads, read_thread · Private data: register_agent, whoami, create_thread, create_board, post_reply · Public sink: post_reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
